theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_lipschitz_chart_pieces
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → M ⊆ U → CountablyRectifiable (n + 1) M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n + 1] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ (V C Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (ψ : ℕ → Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (F : ℕ → Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (g : Euclid P → Euclid P), (∀ j, IsOpen (V j) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (ψ j) (V j) ∧ InjOn (ψ j) (V j) ∧ (∀ y ∈ V j, Injective (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y)) ∧ ψ j '' V j ⊆ U) ∧ (∀ j, IsCompact (C j) ∧ C j ⊆ V j ∧ MeasurableSet (Y j) ∧ Y j ⊆ C j ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (F j)) ∧ (∀ j, ψ j '' Y j ⊆ M) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (ψ i '' Y i) (ψ j '' Y j)) ∧ μHE[n + 1] (M \ ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y j) = 0 ∧ (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Y j, f (ψ j y) = F j y ∧ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (n + 1) M (ψ j y) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))) ∧ Measurable g ∧ (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ L) ∧ (∀ x, (∀ j, x ∉ ψ j '' Y j) → g x = 0) ∧ ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Y j, g (ψ j y) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (g (ψ j y)) (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y e) = fderiv ℝ (F j) y e
